task.description:
Run the EE-01 test suite and write a test report.

1. Run `zig build test` — record exit code and output
2. Check if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is set — if not, integration tests will be skipped (acceptable, document as SKIP)
3. Write report to `tests/reports/EE-01-test-report.json`
4. Complete the handoff
acceptance_criteria: All failures are either PASS or SKIP (no FAIL)

result.summary: zig build test exits 0. Integration tests SKIP (no DB). Unit tests PASS.
